summary: This short wiki note about musician Sky Saxon records his 2008 collaboration with Billy Corgan of the Smashing Pumpkins, on new songs and recordings made with the Seeds. It also notes his cameo in the music video for the Smashing Pumpkins' song "Superchrist" and that his last performance and recording took place in Austin, Texas.
one_line: Sky Saxon's 2008 collaboration with Billy Corgan, his appearance in the Smashing Pumpkins' "Superchrist" video, and his final performance in Austin, Texas.
key_facts: In 2008, Sky Saxon and the Seeds collaborated on some new songs and recordings with Billy Corgan of the Smashing Pumpkins.
Sky Saxon later appeared in the music video of the Smashing Pumpkins' song "Superchrist".
Sky Saxon's last performance and recording was done in Austin, Texas.
